mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (measured as the 3-month change) signals an easing monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined by at least 0.25pp over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% indicates a restrictive monetary policy that increases the cost of capital for corporations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and an increase in payroll employment indicates a strengthening labor market that supports corporate profit growth and consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE declines by at least 0.1pp and PAYEMS increases by at least 50k over the prior 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 0.5% over the past three months signals weakening consumer demand and potential economic deceleration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST declines > 0.5% in 3 months during a late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 2000.0 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces economic growth and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 2000.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and a slowdown in real GDP growth (GDPC1) signals a weakening economy that reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines > 0.5% and GDPC1 growth rate falls below 1.0% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery phase, a sustained increase in the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% signals potential monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.5% during a post-recession recovery.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals robust consumer spending that boosts corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS has increased by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months.
